page.overview:
Who is Faeryn Stormwind?

Faeryn Stormwind is a silver dragonborn monk and Tiberius Stormwind's brother. Orion Acaba played him in a different campaign concurrently with the Vox Machina campaign.

Faeryn hails from Tyriex, Draconia. He speaks Common, Draconic, and Dwarvish. He comes from a very political family. He is an Open Hand monk. His personality is respectful but impatient, and he likes to do things his own way.
